Through the week from 8am-3pm.
Please refer to the edits.

My typical work week is 6-7 12 hour days. Since they were born I haven’t worked more than 5 days yet. I was just outlining what a typical week is going to be. I’ve covered all weekends so far as well as get up during the night on my off days.
So many assumptions here. And I do actually work in a mine, although it’s not a coal mine.

I work 6am-6pm. Been waking up at 4am to take care of them until I have to leave at 5:30. If everything works out, they’ll stay asleep until nanny arrives at 8. 
The 4 out of 5 days was supposed to be 5 but nanny was unavailable one day. The M-F nanny thing is how it’s supposed to be. 
I’ve been handling half the weekend thing. I’ve been up since 2am this morning. It’s noon here and wife is still resting so I feel like I’m doing my part when able. I truly don’t feel like IATA but maybe I am from what everyone is telling me.
Now we’re gatekeeping Disney?
Thanks for the kind words and calling me delusional. When the nanny is here she sleeps almost that entire time, according to her. So yes.
This take is soft. I’ve been up since 2am taking care of my responsibilities while I let my wife sleep. I’m not just hanging her out to dry. I go to sleep at 10pm and wake up to take over at 4am.
Unfortunately our nanny has kids as well so she’s only available during the daytime. I’ve priced overnight help but it’s almost triple what we pay not which I cannot afford.
Harsh words. My job dictates my hours, I don’t get to pick them. I spend as much time as I can when I’m not at work.

Your comment sucks and is full of assumptions. I never “complained” about dad duty. I was outlining the current scenario of things. It’s not “bright and noisy” where I live. We actually have black out curtains. I don’t treat my wife with disrespect. Simply not agreeing on something isn’t disrespecting her.

That’s not what I was suggesting at all but thanks for that. She only has to watch them from 10pm-4am. I wake up at 4 and take over. By her own account, she sleeps during the time the nanny is here. That’s 7 hours during that time compared to my 6 at night.
Did you even read the post? My nanny is also the full time housekeeper. She hasn’t ever had to do any housework.
Not the case but I appreciate you along with others assuming things and running with them as facts in your own mind n
Well, she does. Thanks for your useless input.

Wife sleeps during that time. The nanny cleans house in between feeding/changing babies. The house cleaning was her main job but we’ve told her babies are priority number one. She doesn’t like to sit around so my house is literally as spotless as it ever was before the kids.
She sleeps for 7 hours while the nanny is here. People trying to act like I deny her sleep or something. That’s the whole point of making her the nanny, so she could rest during the day.
That’s correct. This is the arrangement we made. She literally uses that time for sleeping.
Yes we agreed on a 50% raise to her pay. She originally only requested 25% but I didn’t think that was fair so I doubled her request.
Due to reasons I won’t disclose, no, she’s not.
Formula. She can’t breastfeed due to a medical condition.
According to her, yes.
She sleeps the entire 7 hours when the nanny is here. The two hours is what is in between feeding them both. It’s usually 2-3 hours until they fuss again.
If that’s all you read then your opinion means jack shit to me.
Unfortunately, in most cases, “as is” is exactly that. Unless there was a known issue that they lied about and you can PROVE it, you’re stuck with the car.
No, you don’t have a case. You could’ve taken the car to an independent mechanic to have it inspected before buying the car. Never trust the word of someone who’s trying to sell you something.
Others have brought this up. I assure you this is 100% real. I’m not out here karma whoring. I barely ever post anything
Are you under lease with him? If not your options are either to move or deal with the situation. Cheap rent is always a plus but if you can’t deal with the headaches then maybe it’s time to move on.
Yes if you’re so curious. My wife has a medical condition which requires medication that could be transfer to the babies through the milk.
CLEARLY you just assume the fucking worst about everything. It’s her medication for adhd which is a stimulant that can be transferred through milk.
HIPPA violation? You’re truly dense.

Your registration matters more to the state than the city. Update it with your current address and then do it again when you change locations. There shouldn’t be any fees associated with moving cities.

You’ll have to read your agreement with them. A “win” for them could be getting it reduced to a non moving violation. They probably do this on a case by case basis. If you don’t have any evidence to the dispute your guilt, they may not even offer this to you. 

I’ve used traffic lawyers in the past. They can usually get most moving violations reduced to non moving, with you having to pay a larger fine. That’s the give and take.
If they had to incur fees to enforce an eviction to get you to pay rent, why do you think they should have to eat that cost? Pay them what they’re asking and move on.

That’s their choice. They don’t have to inform you your check bounced. They are within their right to file at that point. Bouncing a check is the same as not paying rent. I’m sorry you don’t like what you’re reading.

Look, it doesn’t matter if you bounced a check on purpose or didn’t. Yes, they could’ve reached out to you, that would’ve been the civil thing to do. But they chose the route at which they are legally entitled to. I understand it’s a bad situation. In SC, you have 10 days to respond to the Rule To Vacate. Respond, appear and plead your case to the judge. If you choose to pay your landlord before hand, they can still proceed with the motion or request to have it dismissed.
In some states dealers are regulated by the state via the department of motor vehicles.

Was this a settlement check? The check is almost always made out to plaintiff and attorney. Attorney then deposits into escrow account. Any deducts needed will be taken from said escrow and you will receive a check for the remainder.
Call the police if you absolutely have to have your meds. They may have policy against you having them on school grounds but no one can legally deny you your own prescription medication.
If it’s month to month, could he not give her proper notice to terminate tenancy or create a new agreement with more favorable terms?
Get security cameras recording outside your home. Fast.
He black with a skin condition, right? There’s no way a fucking white kid is that fast.
